We can see the stream details on VRChat with the player's details and name tag who is streaming. 
Twitter and Discord connection is help for send friend request automatically.

There should be the option to have links to your Steam Account/Discord/Whatever on your in-game details page. So that people/your friends can find you outside of VRChat on other social media platforms. Obviously these links should have a switch to change between "Friends Only", "Everyone", etc.

Currently it is possible to log in via Steam but there isn't a way to directly access his/her Steam profile to add him/her. Would it be possible to add a link to the Social menu that refers to his/her Steam profile?
